obligations.requirement: Creation of Shape, Sticky, Table and Image exposes formal selection and selection chrome in the first post-Up presented state.
obligations.oracle: Native creation/placement path plus exact selected/primary/overlay assertions; no second pointer click.
obligations.acceptance: selectedCount=1, primary is the created object (or table root), point acquisition mode is active, and overlay is updated before the next input opportunity.

obligations.requirement: A stationary click on a newly created object remains a click and does not require a compensating click.
obligations.oracle: Creation control and table/placement regressions with immediate state inspection.
obligations.acceptance: No extra operation or second click is needed; text/table edit entry remains valid.

obligations.requirement: Dragging one non-ink object over a mixed scene reuses unchanged content while the active object follows input.
obligations.oracle: Native mixed fixture with long compact ink background and Shape/Sticky/Table/Image; private counters plus independent pixel/order checks.
obligations.acceptance: Static reuse hit after first frame; full-scene draw count does not equal Move count; active transform updates each accepted Move; ordering/opacity are unchanged.

obligations.requirement: Static reuse is basis-bound and bounded.
obligations.acceptance: Any basis change invalidates/rebuilds; no stale image is published; resource leases remain budgeted and GPU lifetime rules remain intact.

obligations.oracle: Existing selected-transform, transient display, render execution and boundary suites.
obligations.acceptance: No regression; UR2c frozen evidence remains untouched.
